actions.reason: The K7_C0002-K7_C0003 boundary is weak and conflicting: all four native geometries show only modest within-versus-between separation (silhouettes 0.046-0.129) with negative fractions up to 0.417, and the pair structural diagnostics show a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.549) that is merge-compatible, together with a moderate-to-high normalized-cut cost (0.640) indicating appreciable cross-boundary connectivity. Although the current two-way labels agree with an independent spectral partition (ARI=1.0), the union is more consistent with a single unit than with two independently retained sets, so the provisional revision to K7_C0002∪K7_C0003 is supported.

actions.reason: K7_C0001 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: coordinated OXPHOS/metabolic down-regulation with concordant adipogenesis, fatty-acid, and bile-acid programs (RNA), plus PBRM1 enrichment (14/14, OR 73.35) with within-panel VHL enrichment (WXS). Its membership is not explained by measured technical factors: set-scope confounder association is null for all site/acquisition factors (q>=0.447). The K7_C0001-K7_C0007 boundary is strongly represented in candidate-consensus geometry (ARI 1.0, within 0.584 vs between 0.172), and although the K7_C0001-K7_C0004 boundary is weaker (ARI 0.758, high normalized-cut 0.596), the union candidate_k=1 is merge-compatible rather than a supported merge, and no split or merge alternative is affirmatively supported. The candidate therefore remains an independent discovery-stage unit.

K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003 has an interpretable transcriptomic phenotype (OXPHOS up-regulation with concordant metabolic programs) and VHL depletion, but its membership is broadly unsupported: all four native geometries show negative mean silhouettes with high negative fractions (CT 0.86, RNA 0.92, WSI 0.89, WXS 0.61), the weakest representation among the larger sets. Its membership remains plausibly explained by measured technical factors: significant set-scope association with tissue source site (V=0.527), CT manufacturer (V=0.413), CT scanner model (V=0.425), CT reconstruction kernel (V=0.469), CT slice thickness (q=9.12e-07), and CT z-spacing (q=9.12e-07). Relevant boundaries are weak or conflicting: the K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003-K7_C0004 boundary is weakly represented (WSI/WXS essentially no distinction) with union candidate_k=1, and the K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003-K7_C0005 boundary is weak-to-moderate with no WXS distinction and union candidate_k=1. No supported split or merge alternative remains, and no remaining evidence could reasonably rescue it.

K7_C0004 has an interpretable immune-suppressed transcriptomic phenotype (allograft rejection, interferon-alpha/gamma, IL6/JAK/STAT3 down-regulation with TGF-beta up-regulation), but its membership is weakly and conflictingly represented: CT near-zero, RNA/WSI weakly positive, WXS strongly negative (78% negative fraction), and no corrected driver-panel mutation signal. Its membership remains plausibly explained by measured technical factors: significant set-scope association with CT phase (V=0.349), CT manufacturer (V=0.222), CT slice thickness (q=0.013), and CT z-spacing (q=0.022). Relevant boundaries are weak or conflicting: the K7_C0001-K7_C0004 boundary is weakly represented (near-zero CT/WSI silhouettes, high negative fractions) with union candidate_k=1, and the K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003-K7_C0004 boundary is weak with union candidate_k=1. The K7_C0004-K7_C0006 boundary is comparatively coherent (ARI 0.871, low normalized-cut 0.311) but its union candidate_k=2 indicates possible internal subdivision rather than a supported merge, and no split or merge alternative is affirmatively supported. No remaining evidence could reasonably rescue it.

K7_C0005 has an interpretable immune-activated transcriptomic phenotype (allograft rejection, interferon-gamma/alpha, IL6/JAK/STAT3 up-regulation) and BAP1 enrichment (10/18, OR 34.17), but its membership is weakly and conflictingly represented: RNA positive, CT near-zero, WSI and WXS negative. Its membership remains plausibly explained by measured technical factors: significant set-scope association with tissue source site (V=0.398) and CT z-spacing (q=0.039). Relevant boundaries are weak or conflicting: the K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003-K7_C0005 boundary is weak-to-moderate with no WXS distinction and union candidate_k=1, and the K7_C0005-K7_C0006 boundary is partially conflicting (strong WXS vs no WSI distinction) with union candidate_k=2 indicating possible internal subdivision rather than a supported merge. No split or merge alternative is affirmatively supported, and no remaining evidence could reasonably rescue it.

K7_C0006 has an interpretable mesenchymal/stromal transcriptomic phenotype (EMT up-regulation with UV-response-DN, mitotic spindle, Hedgehog, angiogenesis) and VHL enrichment with PBRM1 depletion, but its membership is conflictingly represented: CT, RNA, and WSI all negative with high negative fractions (0.85, 0.77, 0.85) while WXS is maximal. Its membership is not explained by measured technical factors (set-scope confounder association null, q>=0.540), but the relevant boundaries do not establish independence: the K7_C0004-K7_C0006 boundary is comparatively coherent (ARI 0.871, low normalized-cut 0.311) yet its union candidate_k=2 indicates possible internal subdivision rather than a supported merge, and the K7_C0005-K7_C0006 boundary is partially conflicting with union candidate_k=2. No split or merge alternative is affirmatively supported, and no remaining evidence could reasonably rescue it.

K7_C0007 has an interpretable proliferation transcriptomic phenotype (E2F targets, G2M checkpoint, MYC targets, glycolysis up-regulation with immune down-regulation), but with only n=4 patients these estimates are highly unstable and the set has no corrected driver-panel mutation signal. Its membership is conflictingly represented: CT near-zero, RNA and WSI strongly negative (100% negative fractions) while WXS is maximal. Its membership is not explained by measured technical factors (set-scope confounder association null, q>=0.333), but power is severely limited. Relevant boundaries do not establish independence: the K7_C0001-K7_C0007 boundary shows material cross-modal disagreement (CT/RNA no separation, WSI/WXS separation) with union candidate_k=1, and the K7_C0004-K7_C0007 boundary is moderately coherent but with high normalized-cut (0.620) and union candidate_k=1. No split or merge alternative is affirmatively supported, and no remaining evidence could reasonably rescue it.
